note: Shards needed per attribute level, by the attribute's rarity. A rarer attribute levels on far fewer shards: a legendary maxes at 24 where a common needs 96.
source: https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Attributes — the community wiki the game's editors moved to. The Fandom wiki this app's attribute list came from publishes only the common column.
verified: The five cumulative maxima (96/64/48/32/24) are exactly the five largest values that appear in member.attributes.stacks on a maxed profile, which is what a maxed attribute of each rarity reads as.
consequence: Applying the common table to every attribute understates how far along every rarer attribute is. A maxed legendary sitting at 24 shards reads as level 5 of 10, so the app invents five levels that do not exist, prices them, and sells them.
